bodyLines: Emrahair is shaped by the expertise of Emrah Çabkur, a hairdresser and colourist who has given his career to colour and cutting, and who is today recognised as Echosline’s Türkiye Ambassador.

His journey began with cutting; over time he put reading hair — its structure, its colour, its light — at the centre of his work. Today he is known above all for Air Touch balayage and for tones lifted without damage. At his salon in Bahçeşehir, colour, cuts, keratin treatments, nails and waxing come together under one roof.
At Emrahair, expertise means more than technical skill. It is the combination of experience, precision, artistry and an understanding of what makes every guest unique.
